connector.name: Liquid
connector.registryDescription: Connect your AI agent to anything - APIs, databases, and agents; read and write, auto-discovered.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package liquid-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ertad-family account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI (or compatible) API key for discovery

env.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
env.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. local Ollama/vLLM

env.name: LIQUID_ALLOW_WRITES
env.description: Set to 1 to expose the liquid_execute write tool (database insert/update/delete). Off by default — read-only.
